name: sortable-media-grid
title: Media grid
description: Media grid. Core/Layout & Containers/Sortable pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Sortable and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /static/images/art/0.svg, /static/images/art/1.svg, /static/images/art/2.svg, /static/images/art/3.svg, /static/images/art/4.svg, /static/images/art/5.svg, /static/images/art/6.svg.
